title: REQ · preload.test.ts proves BootScene uses the planner and the fallback texture
summary: BootScene preload and fallback asserted with mocked Phaser and content
description: Context: BootScene.preload calls planPreload, loads only planned image assets, warns on unknown ones and generates fallback:missing; resolveKey uses resolveTextureKey. Desired behavior: the fallback key is an exported constant and preload.test.ts asserts planner use and fallback resolution. Expected result: passing BootScene tests with phaser, content, gameStore, events and effectContext mocked. Why: criteria of SG-5.4.3.
acceptance_criteria: Given scene refs objects/bed (known) and objects/ghost (unknown), when preload runs, then load.image is called once with objects/bed and its manifest path and a warning names objects/ghost
Given an unknown id, when resolveKey runs, then it returns the exported FALLBACK_KEY
Given a loaderror for a known id, when resolveKey runs, then it returns FALLBACK_KEY

out_of_scope: Behavior changes to preload or resolveKey

technical_constraints: vi.mock phaser, ../src/runtime/content equivalents, store, events and effectContext; no real Phaser
